title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 14)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 14), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This episode addresses arguments regarding divine transcendence over physical limits.
